summary: This directory serves as the test suite for the library, providing verification for request handling, message transformations, and error parsing. It ensures that internal logic maintains expected functional behavior through automated unit and integration tests.
responsibilities: Verify the implementation of fetch creation logic
Validate the correctness of message mapping transformations
Ensure public errors are parsed and handled as expected
relationships: The test suites execute against the library logic to ensure that message mapping and error parsing produce valid outputs from inputs.
Individual test files verify specific library modules to ensure they meet the defined behavioral contracts.
designDecisions: Co-location of test files with implementation logic through a dedicated testing directory
Use of automated test runners to execute suite verification
